description: Bug report from a user of mistune: with the table plugin, the plain text "Name | Age\nJohn | 30\nJane | 25" is rendered as a table with header "Name | Age" and body row "Jane | 25"; the line "John | 30" disappears from the output. Find the problem and fix it. Change src/mistune/ only.
environment: Python >= 3.13 stdlib; base tree = mistune 86f9fd1^ (src, tests, docs, LICENSE, README, pyproject, .gitignore) plus the task-owned helper bench_fixtures/md.py; no repository history
visible_checks: PYTHONPATH=src python -m unittest tests.test_plugins (from the workspace root)
provenance: real fix: lepture/mistune commit 86f9fd1 (fix(table): reject a non-delimiter second row instead of eating it, 2026-07-19); reference/good.patch is that commit's src/ diff; symptom-only description (one text block with a pipe in each line); hidden cases authored for agent-benchmark (2026-10-18): other second rows that are not GFM delimiter rows (text, bordered, mixed, spaced dashes, colons, equals signs) plus guards; table-or-not of every case agrees with markdown-it-py's GFM tables, and inputs where mistune and markdown-it-py differ (single-dash or empty delimiter cells) are excluded; other reference patches built by build_task.py. Public repository: contamination possible
